env.build: origin/main 81601d2 as a git archive snapshot ($SCR/tree) + this change's files copied in (native/afm-bridge/Sources/AFMBridge/Chat.swift, src/dsl/{chunkAnswer,hygiene,index,repair}.ts, src/dsl/parse/chunk.ts, src/dsl/prompts/{chunk,chunkCompact}.ts, src/harness/{turn,types}.ts, src/harness/builtins/worldContext.ts, src/main/inference/{appleChat,ipc}.ts, src/renderer/app/land/witness.ts, src/renderer/narrative/{pipeline,program,turn,witness}.ts, src/shared/llm.ts); none of them differ between HEAD 12c29e7 and origin/main. node_modules and .env symlinked; native/afm-bridge built from the snapshot's own sources (swift build -c debug, 13.6 s); the renderer's Vite cacheDir private and its port fixed to 5199 — both only in the snapshot's electron.vite.config.ts
env.launch: mkdir -p $SCR/<ud>; (cd $SCR/tree && AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/<ud> bunx electron-vite dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9340)   # ud-apple3 for steps 01-04, ud-openai for 11-15; each app closed with {cdp: Browser.close} before the next
env.driver: CDP_PORT=9340 bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(cat docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-witness-names-4k/<step file>)" from the repo root (shot paths are repo-relative)
env.ui: Apple run: zh-TW (system default), so the world and its witnesses are Traditional Chinese — the larger case for a 4K context. OpenAI run: switched to English in step 11, so the world is en-US
env.platform: macOS 27.0, Apple Silicon, Apple Intelligence on (no fm serve), Bun 1.3.6, Electron 44.3.0

model.apple: apple-fm system through the in-app afm-bridge (Settings → Model → 這台電腦 → Apple 裝置端), context 4096 (source: model)
model.openai: openai gpt-5.4-mini, key from the repo .env (the default a fresh userData gets); no context window, so the full witness prompt
